hypotheses.rationale: the sheet gives no windup; 8 ticks sits in the striker basics' 6 to 9
the sheet gives no slug speed; 2800 cm/s is a fast marksman slug above aria's 1800 cm/s basics

forms.name: gravic wake
forms.description: The slug punches through the first enemy and hits a second enemy in line for the same 111 damage; each hit shoves its target 0.5 m (50 cm).

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock coil tap
one extra target keeps the basic below aria's 3-target terminal vector
a 50 cm shove is a light push, well under rook's and titania's 300 cm active knockbacks

forms.name: triple recoil
forms.description: The triple-recoil carriage kicks Vega back 1.5 m (150 cm) as the slug drives its first target back 1 m (100 cm) and passes through to a second enemy; hits deal 126 damage and 10 stability.

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock coil tap
the extra 4 stability stands for the heavier slug of the triple carriage
knockback doubles the transitional 50 cm shove
a 1.5 m recoil is enough to leave the anchored spot, a deliberate cost of the shot

dossier.identity: long-range coil striker who fires best standing still, pushes slugs through lines of enemies and drops delayed blasts on whatever the slug cannot reach.
dossier.selectionRationale: the sheet labels her a striker with a gravic coil rifle. patient penetration shots, a delayed area strike and a bonus for standing still make a stationary marksman: she is distinct from sol's solar beam, aria's moving needle volleys and valkyrie's orbital rupture because her damage is gated by anchoring and her heavy skill is a short delayed circle, not a map-wide strike.
dossier.weaponConcept: gravic coil rifle (anti-materiel coil rifle with a triple-piston recoil carriage, a magnetic accelerator rail, a capacitor unit, a thermal-shroud barrel and a kinetic slug magazine)

lore.backstory: former orbital-debris gunner who learned to hit moving wreckage from kilometres away with a coil rifle built to catch its own recoil in three stages. she left the salvage fleets when the contracts stopped covering the shells and now sets up on rooftops, boots planted, waiting for the exact second the target stops moving.
lore.syndicateRecord: dropped a convoy's lead hauler from nineteen floors up with a single slug, then called the blast on the escort herself.
lore.psychProfile: relaxed, a little smug and extremely patient; counts a lull as a resource and a bigger problem as a better angle.
lore.combatQuote: “bigger problems look better from here. hold still, i’m already on the way down.”

forms.description: Calls a delayed strike up to 16 m (1600 cm) away: after 1.2 s (36 ticks) a blast of radius 2 m (200 cm) deals 260 damage and 30 stability. Cost 40 · windup 0.47 s (14 ticks) · cooldown 19 s (570 ticks).

forms.name: gravic well
forms.description: The blast grows to 3 m (300 cm) radius and leaves enemies slowed by 35% for 2 s (60 ticks); the fuse is 0.9 s (27 ticks); 338 damage and 30 stability.

forms.name: tri-fall
forms.description: Three blasts of 2.5 m (250 cm) radius land in sequence along the aim line, 3 m (300 cm) apart and 0.4 s (12 ticks) apart; each deals 273 damage (70% of 390) and 20 stability and slows by 35% for 2 s (60 ticks); fuse 0.7 s (21 ticks).

iconFamily.subject: a bold coil rifle barrel with a single chunky recoil ring
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Vega. Theme: long recoil. Subject: a bold coil rifle barrel with a single chunky recoil ring. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
